run.name: Weatherford International plc
run.title: CP-OS host session (WFRD)
run.summary: Weatherford has a sound credit profile on reported figures: low leverage and ample liquidity. Earnings are cyclical and currently weakened by Middle East disruption, and the outcome depends on how quickly activity recovers. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. At 2025-12-31. Total debt of 1,485 (carrying, including finance leases) over company adjusted EBITDA of 1,067 for the trailing twelve months; net ratio matches the company's reported 0.42x. EBITDA is a company-defined non-GAAP measure. Analyst-calculated.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Trailing twelve months at 2026-09-30: adjusted EBITDA 1,001 over interest paid of 111 (125 less 71 plus 57). Analyst-calculated; not the covenant interest coverage ratio, whose definition is unseen.

cash.basis: Cash. At 2026-09-30. Commitment 1000 less zero borrowings, 1 financial and 233 performance letters of credit; about 164 of the cash cannot be immediately repatriated. Same limit; uncommitted bilateral lines excluded.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant headroom, ownership detail and the lender effects of the pending corporate move cannot be sourced.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a company-defined measure, and no covenant ratio or compliance figure is reported.
